notes: Fixes a packaging bug that made 2.8.0 crash on launch ("Cannot find module ./miro"). All of 2.8.0’s features are unchanged — the Miro sitemap export, the reworked colour rules, and the card-label fix. If 2.8.0 crashed for you, this release fixes it; if it launched, nothing else is different. See What’s New for the full 2.8.0 feature list.
